style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for the packshot, pale lavender field #EDE9F7 for info and comparison shots, deep ink-purple #2E2A3E reserved for pain-point and closing panels

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent gentle body-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale lavender #EDE9F7, violet accent #8778C8, deep ink-purple #2E2A3E, warm off-white #F5F2FA and clean white #FFFFFF; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with rounded blank badge circles; clean high-end body-care photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright tube angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no model faces or recognizable body identity
style.presentationRules: stable upright tube angle and scale across the set, product never covered by props
style.surfaceSystem: linen-washed stone counter #C9C2B8 and matte ceramic dish, matte paper panels
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one weight family, headline plus short labels only
